target_customer: Medical clinics dealing with insurers (after pivot); security teams (original)
problem: Original idea: security design reviews are slow, so use LLMs to analyze design documents. Later idea: clinics spend time on phone calls to verify patient benefits and check claims.
product_category: AI automation for security reviews, then healthcare insurance calls

founders.name: Sten Sjöberg
founders.background_notes: YC page says he published research at SOUPS.

founders.name: Kevin Kim
founders.background_notes: Software engineer at ExtraHop per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM analysis of design documents, and later voice agents calling insurers, are standard applied AI engineering with hard reliability issues.

defensibility.rationale: Thin application layer on foundation models; no proprietary data or integration lock in is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source records an incumbent copying or buying Remy.

market_need_then: Security teams faced a shortage of reviewers relative to developers per later commentary; no dated evidence from mid 2023 was found. Insurance verification calls are a labor heavy clinic task.

branding.domain_note: Used startremy.com; the domain now shows a parked Namecheap page

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC lists separate Remy Security and Remy pages

brand_strength.rationale: Search results show only unrelated brands named Remy and the company domain is parked.

pivots.from: AI powered security design reviews (Remy Security)
pivots.to: Automating insurance tasks for medical clinics, starting with benefit verification calls
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the YC page description differing from its launch post

outcome_analysis: Remy began as Remy Security applying LLMs to security design reviews in YC Summer 2023, took a small pre-seed, and later described itself as automating insurance calls for medical clinics. The company is Inactive and its domain is parked. No source explains the end; the pivot_failed factor is a weak inference from the change of product with no later traction.
notes: Batch is Summer 2023 (shard lists Summer 2023), so as_of is 2023-06. startremy.com is a parked domain. Funding of 500K comes from VCBacked (pre-seed, September 2023) and CB Insights (500K over 3 rounds, latest November 2023, investors Tekedia Capital, YC, Amino Capital); both are databases, so the round rests on aggregators and investor lists differ. Competitor search found only later aggregator comparisons (Seezo and others), none dated near the batch, so the list is empty. Outcome cause not public.
